artifacts.text: Login fails with AUTH-401.
Support reproduced the identity issue in region-0.
A recent deployment was suspected; rollback did not help.
The SSO certificate expired.
Renewed the SSO certificate and verified login.
Customer confirmed recovery; monitoring stayed healthy.
Uploads stall at 99 percent.
Support reproduced the uploads issue in region-1.
A recent deployment was suspected; rollback did not help.
A stale lock blocks the upload worker.
Cleared the stale lock and restarted the upload worker.
Customer confirmed recovery; monitoring stayed healthy.
Database requests time out.
Support reproduced the database issue in region-2.
A recent deployment was suspected; rollback did not help.
An unindexed lookup scans the entire table.
Added an index and verified database latency returned to normal.
Customer confirmed recovery; monitoring stayed healthy.
New backups fail with insufficient space.
Support reproduced the storage issue in region-0.
A recent deployment was suspected; rollback did not help.
Old snapshots filled the backup disk.
Removed expired snapshots and verified the next backup completed.
Customer confirmed recovery; monitoring stayed healthy.
The application cannot reach its API hostname.
Support reproduced the network issue in region-1.
A recent deployment was suspected; rollback did not help.
A DNS record points to an old IP.
Corrected the DNS record and verified API connectivity.
Customer confirmed recovery; monitoring stayed healthy.
